title: Typography polish: real font outlines (TTF-derived) replacing the 5x7 bitmap-font stopgap
description: 0702 made text visible in published SWFs via a 5x7 bitmap font decomposed into vector rects (packages/swf/src/glyphdata.ts) — functionally correct, visually crude vs Flash 8 (docs/06: FlashType-quality text is a fidelity pillar). Scope: derive DefineFont3 glyph outlines from a real font — embed an open-licensed TTF (or parse system fonts) with an opentype-style parser, convert quadratic outlines to SWF SHAPE records with proper EM-square scaling (1024 units/em x20 for DefineFont3), advance/kerning tables from the font metrics; keep the 5x7 path as fallback. Acceptance: text-rendering e2e still passes AND a new assertion that rendered text is anti-aliased glyph outlines (not blocky rects) — e.g. visual-oracle compare against Ruffle rendering a reference SWF using a real embedded font. Non-gating polish; do after CRITICAL queue is empty.
